cc:Work.dc:title: The most confident mistakes
cc:Work.dc:description: For each model, the eight incorrect argmax predictions with highest confidence; ties use date and match ID. Labels show actual score. This post-hoc diagnostic does not alter parameters or recalibrate forecasts; high confidence is not certainty.
